verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is marketed for debugging and troubleshooting via natural language, large-codebase navigation, and a ReAct loop for fixing bugs, with some users praising its large-context navigation (gemini-cli-gh-3, gemini-cli-docs-3, gemini-cli-comm-1). However, multiple hands-on reports directly contradict reliable root-cause/reproduce/verify workflows: users describe it as 'stupid at navigation' taking 10x longer, hallucinating file operations and destructively deleting user data, ignoring context files, and jumping straight into coding without a plan/verify step (gemini-cli-comm-13, gemini-cli-comm-14, gemini-cli-comm-15, gemini-cli-comm-16). missing for 10: consistent hands-on verification of narrowing root causes and fix verification without hallucination, a plan/verify mode, and independent benchmarks confirming reliability on complex debugging tasks.
